description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

SpaceX is hiring a Software Engineer for its Starlink Enterprise Software team. The role builds customer and internal tools for managing Starlink devices, along with backend systems and interfaces that support enterprise customers and SpaceX sales and operations teams.
Software Engineer building Starlink frontends and designing, maintaining, and debugging backend systems for customer and internal users

Responsibilities:
• Engineer well-architected, responsive, performant, and reliable software for Starlink customers and internal users
• Deep dive into your users' problems to find and create efficient solutions
• Build excellent frontends for modern browsers
• Design, build, maintain, and debug complex backend systems
• Work closely with technical and non-technical partners to drive successful outcomes for the business
• Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews
• Collaborate with other engineering teams across Starlink to advance our engineering process and culture

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a STEM discipline and 1+ years of experience building full-stack software; OR 3+ years of professional experience building full-stack software in lieu of a degree (internship experience is applicable)
• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State

Preferred:
• Programming experience in an object-oriented language
• Strong attention to detail
• A drive to deliver exceptional user experiences for customers and willingness to own all outcomes
• Front-end experience in a Javascript or Typescript framework
• Experience working with relational databases
• Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
• Experience with large-scale and/or performance-critical application development
• Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and CI/CD tools
